description: Western Province Provincial Council - Extention of the date to submit report pertaining to Wattala-Mabola Urban Council
reasoning: This gazette concerns the extension of a judicial inquiry being conducted by a retired Court of Appeal judge into potential offenses committed by an Urban Council and its Chairman. The content focuses on a law enforcement/judicial process (an inquiry under the Urban Councils Ordinance) and involves a judicial officer (a retired judge). This falls under the Judicial/Law Enforcement category (Type 9) as it deals with legal proceedings and judicial appointments for investigative purposes, rather than general government personnel changes or structural reorganizations.
